visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a gray checkered shirt stands behind a bar counter, looking startled. A bright red neon sign saying 'TAIWAN BAR' glows behind him next to shelves filled with various liquor bottles. He holds a green food packet in his hands. (2) Static portrait images of two elderly Caucasian scholars are displayed. The first scholar is shown with a flower garland and lei, while the second is dressed in a formal dark suit, both appearing as authoritative academic figures. (3) The man returns to the bar setting, gesturing enthusiastically with his hands while explaining historical theories. His facial expressions are highly animated, characterized by wide eyes and rapid mouth movements synchronized with his speech. (4) A high-resolution close-up of a young woman's eyes and upper face is shown. Her features are clear and well-lit, intended to emphasize physical traits relevant to the linguistic and ethnic discussion being narrated. (5) An animated graphic map of the Pacific and Southeast Asian region appears, featuring bold red arrows radiating from Taiwan. Dates such as '3500 BP' and '1200 BP' are labeled on the routes against a clean white and gray map background. (6) The man is shown again at the bar, and a digital overlay of a 'Nature' magazine cover titled 'LANIAKEA' is superimposed over his chest to lend scientific weight to the topic. (7) A dynamic wide shot depicts five young people in swimwear running into the ocean. They are splashing water under bright daylight, with a clear blue sea and horizon visible in the background. (8) The man concludes by pointing directly at the camera, followed by a graphic transition to the 'Taiwan Bar' YouTube channel interface and a promotional thumbnail for a video titled 'The Earliest Taiwanese'.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 歷史客棧. [Slogan]: 如果時光機都帶不出來看這. [Subtitle]: 老湯你又在偷吃?. (2) [Subtitle]: 什麼偷吃? 臺灣真的是南島語族的發源地嗎?. (3) [Subtitle]: 有些學者這樣講. (4) [Subtitle]: 美國語言學家白樂思跟澳洲的考古學家貝爾伍德. (5) [Subtitle]: 他們曾經提出出臺灣說. (6) [Subtitle]: 出臺灣說?. (7) [Subtitle]: 南島語族的語言有一些相似處. (8) [Subtitle]: 像臺灣很多原住民的族語在說眼睛是用 mata. (9) [Subtitle]: 很多地方原住民族語的眼睛也都是 mata. (10) [Subtitle]: 語言學家就是透過這些語言相似度去溯源. (11) [Subtitle]: 就發現欸語言的起源地應該在臺灣喔. (12) [Subtitle]: 我大臺灣是走遍半個地球囉. (13) [Subtitle]: 也不能這樣說, 它就是一個學界假說. (14) [Subtitle]: 也有登上 Nature 期刊. (15) [Subtitle]: 說哇這就是臺灣帶給世界的禮物. (16) [Subtitle]: 但是有些學者不同意. (17) [Subtitle]: 像是臺大人類學系陳有貝教授. (18) [Subtitle]: 就認為說與其說臺灣原住民跟其他南島語族是祖先跟子孫的關係. (19) [Subtitle]: 他們更接近平行的兄弟姐妹間的關係. (20) [Subtitle]: 反正就是學界還有得吵. (21) [Subtitle]: 好酷喔我要聽繼續講. (22) [Subtitle]: 這個問題很有趣, 如果大家感興趣的話就去看. (23) [Slogan]: 新動畫臺灣史 最早的臺灣人 最新的第1集. (24) [Logo]: Taiwan Bar.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male narrator begins speaking over a driving electronic pop BGM with a strong synthetic beat. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the opening title sequence. The vocal is crisp and professionally mixed, positioned front and center in the soundstage. (2) The narration becomes more analytical as he lists names of scholars. The BGM remains steady in the background, providing a bright, rhythmic foundation. A subtle 'ding' SFX punctuates the introduction of a new scientific theory, marking a shift in the conversational focus. (3) The speaker's pitch rises during a rhetorical question about linguistic origins. The BGM tempo remains consistent at approximately 125 BPM. No environmental noise is present, suggesting a controlled studio environment. The interplay between the fast-paced speech and the electronic rhythm creates a sense of informative urgency. (4) A final 'pop' sound effect triggers the conclusion of the audio track as the narrator points out a call-to-action. The BGM swells slightly before a clean fade-out, coinciding with the end of the promotional narration for the YouTube channel.
